task.title: Reject blank acceptance criterion descriptions
task.goal: Keep Chora acceptance criteria reviewable by requiring a non-blank description.

requirement.statement: An acceptance criterion must explain what its title means; blank or whitespace-only descriptions are rejected.
constraints: Preserve existing valid acceptance criterion behavior.
Do not change persistence, Public API, UI, Runtime, or Sandbox code.
Return a reviewable patch limited to the declared files.

desired_behavior: NewAcceptanceCriterion accepts a non-blank title and description.
NewAcceptanceCriterion rejects an empty or whitespace-only description.
Task construction and existing Domain tests remain green.
out_of_scope: Changing acceptance criterion IDs or serialization.

criteria.title: Blank descriptions fail closed
criteria.description: Empty and whitespace-only descriptions return domain.ErrInvalidArgument.

criteria.title: Valid criteria remain stable
criteria.description: A valid title and description are retained without unrelated behavior changes.

technical_plan.summary: Tighten the existing AcceptanceCriterion constructor and add focused regression coverage.

steps.description: Add focused constructor tests for valid, empty, and whitespace-only descriptions.
Require a trimmed non-empty description in NewAcceptanceCriterion.
Format both files and run the declared Domain test command.

decisions.question: Which repository task proves the first real coding path?
decisions.resolution: Use the Chora Domain validation task pinned in this contract.
decisions.rationale: It is a real, reviewable product change with a two-file boundary and deterministic tests.

decisions.question: Which single Runtime and Sandbox combination enters the fresh Entry Probe?
decisions.resolution: Pi Coding Agent 0.84.1 over JSONL RPC in one disposable Colima-backed Docker container per Attempt.
decisions.rationale: Runtime, model, Sandbox, base images, configuration, and policy identities remain separate and immutable.

decisions.question: How can the Attempt reach Ollama without general network access?
decisions.resolution: Attach the Attempt only to an internal private network and expose a task-scoped fixed Ollama upstream boundary.
decisions.rationale: The Attempt cannot route to the host or Internet while the boundary can be identified, audited, and removed.

risks.description: The selected model may fail Pi tool calling or the boundary may not reach the host Ollama endpoint.
risks.mitigation: Record semantic failures separately; stop after two and require explicit user authority before replacing the Task model.

risks.description: A host mount, network route, process, or cleanup mistake could violate the Sandbox boundary.
risks.mitigation: Fail closed on host access, general egress, process-tree death, identity, or cleanup uncertainty.

unknowns.question: Can the pinned Pi RPC and Task model edit one file and cleanly terminate under the v2 policy on this host?

base_images.purpose: Runtime, boundary, and Chora test stage
